verdict.rationale: Google publishes a dedicated deprecations page tracking announced earliest shutdown dates and already-shutdown models, plus a maintained release-notes changelog, and documents that `-latest` aliases move while versioned IDs stay pinnable — together this constitutes a documented deprecation policy with advance notice and a migration path (pin to versioned IDs). Missing for 10: no explicit stated minimum notice period (e.g., '6 months notice'), no independent/community corroboration of the policy being honored in practice, and no dedicated migration-guide content beyond alias/versioning notes.
